title: Transpose of the strict normalized Hom numerator for arbitrary coefficient modules
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small in the module universe, $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings, $P$ a flat-term K-flat complex of $R$-module sheaves, $C$ any unbounded $R$-complex, and $T$ any $R$-module sheaf, regarded as a complex in degree zero [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Use localization $Q$, the normalized derived tensor-Hom structure $H_R$, and its fixed Hom representative and inverse localized augmentation [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model] [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] [def-coef-hom-representative-evaluation]. In the strict models [def-sfb-internal-hom-strict-models] [def-sfb-internal-hom-strict-roof], write $\eta_M:M\to I_R(M)$, $J=I_R(C)$, $B=\mathcal Hom_R^\bullet(P,J)$ and $A=T\otimes_R B$, where $\otimes$ is the actual total sheaf tensor. Let $a_T:A\to\mathcal Hom_R^\bullet(P,I_R(T\otimes_R J))$ be the fixed normalized comparison. Then evaluation into $QC$, under $QB\cong H_R(QP,QC)$, is represented by $\operatorname{ev}_J:B\otimes_R P\to J$, $f\otimes p\mapsto f(p)$, followed by $[\eta_C]^{-1}$. There is a chain map $h_T:A\otimes_R P\to T\otimes_R J$ with formula $(t\otimes f)\otimes p\mapsto t\otimes f(p)$ on every slice and homogeneous total-tensor summand. The uncurried chain map of $a_T$ is exactly $\eta_{T\otimes_R J}\circ h_T$, tested with the actual product-Hom projections and sheafification units. Consequently the derived tensor-Hom transpose of $[a_T]:QA\to H_R(QP,Q(T\otimes_R J))$ is $[h_T]$. Here $Q(A\otimes_R P)$ computes $QA\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}QP$; neither $A$ nor $T$ is required to be flat. These identifications are natural in $T$, contravariantly in $P$, and covariantly in $C$, and commute with compatible coefficient maps and inversion of quasi-isomorphisms of the complex representatives. The tensor order is $A,P$, so no interchange sign is inserted. No boundedness, finite generation or continuity assumption is made.
